hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^\s*git(\s+-C\s+\S+)?\s+commit\b' || exit 0; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qi 'co-authored-by'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Commit message contains Co-Authored-By trailer.
